projectBackground.name: Payroll Consolidation
projectBackground.budget: Payroll budget: €15,000 per month for service
projectBackground.context: Two payroll systems are being merged. Errors in last month's pay led to complaints.

manager.name: Agnieszka Nowak
manager.role: Head of Payroll, People First Partners
manager.note: People live on their pay. Get it right, on time, with a trail.

assignment.title: Run the payroll accurately
assignment.brief: Compute net pay, employer cost and overtime, complete the payroll table in Excel and set controls.

documents.name: Pay Rates
documents.note: Income tax 18%; employee social 7%; employer social 15%.

documents.name: Overtime Sheet
documents.note: Six hours at 1.5x; base €20 per hour.

documents.name: Complaint Log
documents.note: Three employees paid late or incorrectly.

tasks.title: Net Pay
tasks.prompt: Gross €4,000; tax 18%; employee social 7%. What is net pay (€)?
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Employer Cost
tasks.prompt: Gross €4,000 plus employer social 15%. What is total employer cost (€)?
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Overtime
tasks.prompt: Base €20/hour, 6 hours at 1.5x. What is overtime pay (€)?
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Payroll Controls
options: Separation between those who set up and those who approve pay
Change reports reviewed before each run
tasks.mistake: Single-person payroll is a fraud risk.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Payroll Table (Excel)
tasks.prompt: Tax (C = B x 0.18), employee social (D = B x 0.07), net pay (E = B - C - D).
tasks.reasoning: Net pay is about 75% of gross at these rates.
tasks.mistake: Typing numbers instead of formulas causes errors.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Payslip Query Reply
tasks.prompt: Write a 3-5 sentence reply to an employee who says their pay is short.
tasks.modelAnswer: Thank you for raising this. I have checked your payslip: your gross pay of €4,000 was reduced by income tax of €720 and employee social contributions of €280, giving net pay of €3,000. I could not find overtime for last week; please send the approved timesheet and I will include it in this month's run if confirmed. I will reply by end of day tomorrow.
tasks.reasoning: A good reply explains the calculation and states the next step and date.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

caseStudy.title: Case Study: The Ghost Employee
caseStudy.background: A payroll clerk added a former employee and paid £90,000 to a personal account over two years. No one reconciled headcount to payroll.
caseStudy.solution: People First introduced headcount reconciliation and dual approval.
